70444-french-english.title: A Comparison
70444-french-english.creator: Unknown
70444-french-english.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In England there is not much physical education of a formal and methodical nature; the English are not remarkable for a love of gymnastic exercises, and they seldom train or develop the body scientifically except when they prepare themselves for boat races. In saying this I leave out of consideration the small class of professional athletes, which is not numerous enough to affect the nation generally.

arxiv-2202-04171.title: Inferring Strategies from Observations in Long Iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma Experiments
arxiv-2202-04171.creator: Eladio Montero-Porras eladio.montero@vub.be, Jelena Grujić jelenagr@gmail.com, Elias Fernandez-Domingos elias.fernandez.domingos@vub.be, Tom Lenaerts tom.lenaerts@vub.be
arxiv-2202-04171.description: Abstract While many theoretical studies have revealed the strategies that could lead to and maintain cooperation in the Iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma, less is known about what human participants actually do in this game and how strategies change when being confronted with anonymous partners in each round.

arxiv-2207-11820.title: Optimizing Resource Allocation and VNF Embedding in RAN Slicing
arxiv-2207-11820.creator: Tu N. Nguyen, Kashyab J. Ambarani, My T. Thai
arxiv-2207-11820.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tu N. Nguyen, Kashyab J. Ambarani, My T. Thai. 5G radio access network (RAN) with network slicing methodology plays a key role in the development of the next-generation network system. RAN slicing focuses on splitting the substrate’s resources into a set of self-contained programmable RAN slices . Leveraged by network function virtualization (NFV), a RAN slice is constituted by various virtual network functions (VNFs) and virtual links that are embedded as instances on substrate nodes.

arxiv-2401-12065.title: Annular Links from Thompson’s Group T T Thanks: The author acknowledges partial suport from the NSF RTG Grant DMS-1839968 and NSF Grant DMS-2105467
arxiv-2401-12065.creator: Louisa Liles
arxiv-2401-12065.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Louisa Liles. In 2014 Jones showed how to associate links in the 3 3 -sphere to elements of Thompson’s group F F . We provide an analogue of this program for annular links and Thompson’s group T T . The main result is that any edge-signed graph embedded in the annulus is the Tait graph of an annular link built from an element of T T .

arxiv-2402-17641.title: Variational Learning is Effective for Large Deep Networks
arxiv-2402-17641.creator: Yuesong Shen, Nico Daheim, Bai Cong, Peter Nickl, Gian Maria Marconi, Clement Bazan, Rio Yokota, Iryna Gurevych, Daniel Cremers, Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan, Thomas Möllenhoff
arxiv-2402-17641.description: Abstract We give extensive empirical evidence against the common belief that variational learning is ineffective for large neural networks. We show that an optimizer called Improved Variational Online Newton (IVON) consistently matches or outperforms Adam for training large networks such as GPT-2 and ResNets from scratch. IVON’s computational costs are nearly identical to Adam but its predictive uncertainty is better.

arxiv-2501-04625.title: Chondrule dust rim growth: Influence of restructuring using molecular dynamics simulations
arxiv-2501-04625.creator: Chuchu Xiang, Nina Merkert (née Gunkelmann), Lorin S. Matthews, Augusto Carballido, Truell W. Hyde
arxiv-2501-04625.description: Abstract We investigate the influence of disruptive collisions on chondrule rim growth, emphasizing the role of kinetic energy in determining the outcomes of these interactions. We establish a threshold of approximately 10 cm/s for the ”hit-and-stick” collision regime, beyond which significant changes occur in the structure of rimmed chondrules.

arxiv-2502-18850.title: Gate-voltage-driven quantum phase transition at 0.7 ​ ( 2 ​ e 2 / h ) 0.7(2e^{2}/h) in quantum point contacts
arxiv-2502-18850.creator: Jongbae Hong
arxiv-2502-18850.description: Abstract We investigate a quantum phase transition (QPT) in quantum point contacts by analyzing the gate-voltage-dependent quasiparticle energy at the Fermi level at zero temperature. This energy is computed using the local density of states at the site of the localized spin, which is extracted from the replicated gate-voltage-dependent differential conductance shaped by entangled-state tunneling.

arxiv-2504-01726.title: Shared-Memory Hierarchical Process Mapping
arxiv-2504-01726.creator: Christian Schulz, Henning Woydt
arxiv-2504-01726.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Christian Schulz, Henning Woydt. Modern large-scale scientific applications consist of thousands to millions of individual tasks. These tasks involve not only computation but also communication with one another. Typically, the communication pattern between tasks is sparse and can be determined in advance. Such applications are executed on supercomputers, which are often organized in a hierarchical hardware topology, consisting of islands, racks, nodes, and processors, where processing elements reside.

arxiv-2504-09429.title: Galois groups of reductions modulo p p of D D -finite series
arxiv-2504-09429.creator: Xavier Caruso, Florian Fürnsinn, Daniel Vargas-Montoya
arxiv-2504-09429.description: Abstract The aim of this paper is to investigate the algebraicity behavior of reductions of D D -finite power series modulo prime numbers. For many classes of D D -finite functions, such as diagonals of multivariate algebraic series or hypergeometric functions, it is known that their reductions modulo prime numbers, when defined, are algebraic.

arxiv-2504-16740.title: Gaussian Splatting is an Effective Data Generator for 3D Object Detection Thanks: Qualcomm AI Research is an initiative of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
arxiv-2504-16740.creator: Farhad G. Zanjani, Davide Abati, Auke Wiggers, Dimitris Kalatzis, Hong Cai, Amirhossein Habibian
arxiv-2504-16740.description: Abstract We investigate data augmentation for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. We utilize recent advancements in 3D reconstruction based on Gaussian Splatting for 3D object placement in driving scenes. Unlike existing diffusion-based methods that synthesize images conditioned on BEV layouts, our approach places 3D objects directly in the reconstructed 3D space with explicitly imposed geometric transformations.

arxiv-2505-07615.title: Diffused Responsibility: Analyzing the Energy Consumption of Generative Text-to-Audio Diffusion Models
arxiv-2505-07615.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Text-to-audio models have recently emerged as a powerful technology for generating sound from textual descriptions. However, their high computational demands raise concerns about energy consumption and environmental impact. In this paper, we conduct an analysis of the energy usage of 7 state-of-the-art text-to-audio diffusion-based generative models, evaluating to what extent variations in generation parameters affect energy consumption at inference time. We also aim to identify an optimal balance between audio quality and energy consumption by considering Pareto-optimal solutions across all selected models.

arxiv-2507-12224.title: Optimizers Qualitatively Alter Solutions And We Should Leverage This
arxiv-2507-12224.creator: Razvan Pascanu, Clare Lyle, Ionut-Vlad Modoranu, Naima Elosegui Borras, Dan Alistarh, Petar Velickovic, Sarath Chandar, Soham De, James Martens
arxiv-2507-12224.description: Abstract Due to the nonlinear nature of deep neural networks, one can not guarantee convergence to a unique global minimum of the loss when using optimizers that rely only on local information, such as gradient descent. Indeed, this was a primary source of skepticism regarding the feasibility of neural networks in the early days of the field.

arxiv-2508-10993.title: Match & Choose: Model Selection Framework for Fine-tuning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
arxiv-2508-10993.creator: Basile Lewandowski, Lydia Y. Chen, Robert Birke
arxiv-2508-10993.description: Abstract . Text-to-image (T2I) models based on diffusion and transformer architectures advance rapidly. They are often pretrained on large corpora, and openly shared on a model platform, such as HuggingFace. Users can then build up AI applications, e.g., generating media contents, by adopting pretrained T2I models and fine-tuning them on the target dataset.

arxiv-2512-04290.title: More is different: Case studies of how chemical complexity influences stability in high entropy oxides
arxiv-2512-04290.creator: Ksenia Khoroshun, Mario U. González-Rivas, Alannah M. Hallas
arxiv-2512-04290.description: Abstract ABSTRACT Tailoring the chemical composition of a high entropy oxide (HEO) is a powerful approach to enhancing desirable material properties. However, the targeted synthesis of HEO materials is often hindered by competing stabilizing and destabilizing factors, which are difficult to predict.

pmc-11305590.title: The evolutionary and molecular history of a chikungunya virus outbreak lineage
pmc-11305590.creator: Janina Krambrich, Filip Mihalič, Michael W. Gaunt, Jon Bohlin, Jenny C. Hesson, Åke Lundkvist, Xavier de Lamballerie, Cixiu Li, Weifeng Shi, John H.-O. Pettersson, Wojciech Makalowski, Andrea Marzi, Wojciech Makalowski, Andrea Marzi, Wojciech Makalowski, Andrea Marzi
pmc-11305590.description: In 2018–2019, Thailand experienced a nationwide spread of chikungunya virus (CHIKV), with approximately 15,000 confirmed cases of disease reported. Here, we investigated the evolutionary and molecular history of the East/Central/South African (ECSA) genotype to determine the origins of the 2018–2019 CHIKV outbreak in Thailand.

pmc-11416087.title: Buscando Luciérnagas: findings on Mexican fireflies from an 8-year virtual citizen science project
pmc-11416087.creator: Ek del-Val, Ana M. Flores-Gutiérrez, Regina González, Adrián Calleros
pmc-11416087.description: Fireflies are charismatic and conspicuous animals that often evoke childhood memories, which make firefly watching an emotional and even transformative experience. Citizen science projects have the potential to enhance transformative interactions with nature. Like many insects, firefly populations are declining due to land-use change, urbanization and watershed pollution, but ecological data for this group is scarce, particularly in Mexico.

pmc-11437929.title: The multidimensional influence structure of college students’ online gamified learning engagement: A hybrid design based on QCA-SEM
pmc-11437929.creator: Hongfeng Zhang, Fanbo Li
pmc-11437929.description: In the post-epidemic era, gamification is widely recognized for its potential to enhance the asynchronous nature of college students' online learning interactions and mitigate efficiency deficits. However, the intrinsic structure and core conditions influencing online gamified learning engagement remain unclear. The challenge lies in understanding the mechanisms through which gamification alters learning behaviors.

pmc-11648868.title: Tablet formulation for ophthalmic disease prevention using a combination of lutein and naringin extracted from the flower of Tagetes erecta L. and fruit membrane of Citrus maxima (Burm.f.) Merr. extract
pmc-11648868.creator: Pornpun Laovachirasuwan, Natthanan Chainom, Sirinthra Kaengin, Somsak Nualkaew
pmc-11648868.description: This study aimed to develop a dietary supplement tablet for the prevention of ophthalmic diseases using extracts from Tagetes erecta L. flowers and Citrus maxima (Burm.f.) Merr. fruit membranes. To enhance the extraction of lutein from T. erecta flowers and total phenolic compounds and naringin from C. maxima fruit membranes, a novel technique, enriched fraction column chromatography, was employed.

pmc-11712781.title: Plasma phospho‐tau 217 rises with and not before early tau aggregation measured by MK6240 PET
pmc-11712781.creator: Azadeh Feizpour, Vincent Dore, James D. Doecke, Colin L Masters, Christopher C. Rowe
pmc-11712781.description: BackgroundRise in plasma phospho‐tau (pTau) is hypothesized to reflect a physiological response to brain Aß plaques, preceding the formation of neurofibrillary tangles (NFT). An alternate explanation is poor sensitivity of tau PET for detection of early NFT formation. The tau tracer MK6240 has very low background “off‐target” binding and may better detect early tau aggregation.

pmc-12469118.title: Carbon-Ion Radiotherapy for Prostate Cancer in Patients with a History of Surgery for Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
pmc-12469118.creator: Atsushi Okato, Kosei Miura, Tomoki Yamaguchi, Mio Nakajima, Hirokazu Makishima, Takanobu Utsumi, Koichiro Akakura, Hiroyoshi Suzuki, Masaru Wakatsuki, Hiroshi Tsuji, Tomohiko Ichikawa, Hitoshi Ishikawa, Matthias May, Ingmar Wolff
pmc-12469118.description: Simple SummaryThe safety of carbon-ion radiotherapy for prostate cancer in patients with a history of surgery for benign prostatic hyperplasia remains unclear. This study evaluated the long-term outcomes in patients who underwent carbon-ion radiotherapy. The treatment resulted in favorable cancer control and an acceptable incidence of urinary complications.

pmc-12627226.title: BARRIERS AND FACILITATORS TO PROVIDING COVID-19 CONTACT TRACING INFORMATION AMONG ADULT NIGERIANS
pmc-12627226.creator: ODIKPO Linda Chihurumnanya, BALAS Ayuba, UBAH Chinenye, MBADUGHA Chisom, NDUBUISI-OKOROEZI Lovelyn, IKECHUKWU-OKOROEZI Jennifer
pmc-12627226.description: Background –Contact tracing information as one of the measures of COVID-19 control had been met with some barriers and facilitators. This study was set to identify barriers and facilitators to providing COVID-19 contact tracing information among adult Nigerians.Materials and Methods –The study was a prospective web-based cross-sectional descriptive design.

pmc-12660861.title: A multi-criterion feature integration framework for accurate diagnosis of Sjögren’s disease using routine laboratory tests
pmc-12660861.creator: Shu Liu, Guanhao Wu, Mengge Pan, Qi Sun, Chenjing Gao, Xianming Long, Chaogui Tang, Xinran Yuan, Lingyun Sun
pmc-12660861.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Sjögren’s disease (SjD) is a common systemic autoimmune disease that remains difficult to diagnose early due to non-specific symptoms and lack of definitive biomarkers. This multicentre retrospective cohort study analysed data from 34,958 patients across three hospitals in China to assess the diagnostic potential of routine laboratory tests and to develop a robust, low-cost artificial intelligence model, the Sjögren Multi-criterion Feature Integration Framework (SMFIF). This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06982482).

pmc-12931105.title: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation: latest evidence, gaps in knowledge, and future directions
pmc-12931105.creator: Dario Mafrica, Artur Dziewierz, Dobromir Dobrev, Francesco Pelliccia
pmc-12931105.description: Aortic stenosis (AS) remains the most prevalent valvular heart disease worldwide and is increasingly managed through transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI). With the 2025 ESC/EACTS Guidelines lowering the age threshold for TAVI to 70 years, the focus has shifted from short-term survival to lifetime management, necessitating rigorous evaluation of device durability, coronary access, and biological valve degeneration.

pmc-13319698.title: Artificial intelligence in rheumatology: a cross-sectional Scopus-based analysis
pmc-13319698.creator: Dinmukhammed Otebay, Gulnara Kapanova, Bekaidar Nurmashev, Maidan Mukhamediyarov, Burhan Fatih Kocyigit
pmc-13319698.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in clinical medicine. Rheumatology is well-suited to AI applications due to diagnostic complexity of rheumatic diseases, variable disease presentations, and multisystem involvement. This cross-sectional study examines global AI research in rheumatology through bibliometric analysis of Scopus data.

pmc-13400594.title: Baseline immunonutritional status drives CAR T-cell efficacy, survival, and safety in R/R lymphoma: validation of a pre-lymphodepletion PNI threshold
pmc-13400594.creator: Na Zhang, Fan Yang, Rui Liu, Zhonghua Fu, Danyang Li, Yuelu Guo, Lixia Ma, Miaomiao Cao, Biping Deng, Shilin Gan, Chen Chen, Xiaoyan Ke, Kai Hu
pmc-13400594.description: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy has revolutionized the treatment landscape for relapsed/refractory (R/R) lymphoma. However, heterogeneous responses and treatment-related toxicities remain significant challenges. The prognostic nutritional index (PNI), reflecting both nutritional status and systemic immune competence, has emerged as a potential biomarker in various malignancies.

pmc-13451817.title: A four-year journey towards clinical remission and background therapies optimization with benralizumab: A retrospective analysis☆
pmc-13451817.creator: Laura Pini, Diego Bagnasco, Bianca Beghè, Fulvio Braido, Paolo Cameli, Marco Caminati, Cristiano Caruso, Claudia Crimi, Alice D'Adda, Gabriella Guarnieri, Manuela Latorre, Francesco Menzella, Andrea Vianello, Dina Visca, Benedetta Bondi, Yehia El Masri, Jordan Giordani, Andrea Mastrototaro, Matteo Maule, Alessandro Pini, Stefano Piras, Martina Zappa, Gianenrico Senna, Antonio Spanevello, Pierluigi Paggiaro, Francesco Blasi, Giorgio Walter Canonica, SANI Study Group

pmc-13637158.title: Clinical features and long-term surgical outcomes of ureteral endometriosis with hydroureteronephrosis: a retrospective study
pmc-13637158.creator: Xinyue Tang, Zhiyue Gu, Yi Dai, Xiaoyan Li, Shiqing Lyu, Yushi Wu, Chenyu Zhang, Qiutong Li, Hailan Yan, Yuanyuan Li, Jinghua Shi, Jinhua Leng
pmc-13637158.description: BackgroundUreteral endometriosis with hydroureteronephrosis can impair renal function, yet few clear guidelines exist for its surgical treatment. This study aimed to compare the clinicopathological features between patients undergoing ureterolysis with nodule excision versus segmental ureterectomy with anastomosis for ureteral endometriosis with hydroureteronephrosis, and to report the postoperative outcomes.
